about: The painted backdrop beyond the inner city's walkable area (map/BUILDING.md: painting, not models). tools/backdrop.mjs restyles each panel from the scroll strip that lies past that edge (scan rect u0,v0,u1,v1), with prompts/backdrop_panel.txt + the panel's content prompt, and fades its edges into mist; web/src/backdrop.js stands the panels on a ring round the section (angles: 0 = east, 90 = north, 180 = west) and veils everything outside the painted area in mist (the scroll's blank silk). East is the gate (S5), built: no panel. North: the silk's top edge cuts the far row and nothing is painted above it: mist only. South (below the silk's edge): mist only.

panels.why: S7 (the end: the 解 building, 赵太丞家, the official riding out, the gatehouse, the willows to the cut edge) lies past the west seam and is not built yet
